## Failed Tests — Detail

### ❌ Personal Disability Cover — Workability (ACB-2648) › AC03b: Increasing Claim default (STORY says ticked) — CONFIRMED DISCREPANCY (app shows unticked)

**Acceptance Criteria (from user story):**

> AC03: "Optional Benefits — Increasing Claim (default ticked)".
> 
> Steps to reproduce:
> 1. New quote (Employed, $150k). 2. Activate Workability. 3. Read the Increasing Claim checkbox.
> 
> Expected: Increasing Claim ticked by default.
> Actual (CONFIRMED DISCREPANCY, probe 2026-09-04): Increasing Claim is UNticked by default for
> Workability (unlike M&L and IP where it IS default-ticked). Encoded to the spec's expected value
> (ticked) and EXPECTED TO FAIL until the app default is corrected — see the Discrepancy Evidence
> Record in the test doc. Not weakened to match the app.

**What was compared:**

| Check | Expected | Actual |
|---|---|---|
| Workability Increasing Claim default (story: ticked) | true | false |

**Assertion failure:**

```
Error: AC03: Increasing Claim default-ticked (per story)

expect(received).toBe(expected) // Object.is equality

Expected: true
```

![Personal Disability Cover — Workability (ACB-2648) › AC03b: Increasing Claim default (STORY says ticked) — CONFIRMED DISCREPANCY (app shows unticked)](data:image/png;base64,)

**Acceptance Criteria (from user story):**

> AC13: Given Workability, When age next birthday < 17, Then error "The minimum Age Next Birthday for Workability is 17".
> 
> Steps to reproduce:

## Skipped / Blocked Tests — Detail

### ⏭️ Personal Disability Cover — Workability (ACB-2648) › AC09/AC09A/AC10: Workability × Business Disability / Farmers / Business Expenses conjunction errors

**Acceptance Criteria (from user story):**

> AC09/AC09A/AC10: Workability cannot coexist with Business Disability, Farmers Disability, or Business Expenses (order-dependent conjunction error). These are BUSINESS-policy disability covers.

**Why skipped:**

> Deferred: AC09/AC09A/AC10 require Business-policy disability covers (Business Disability / Farmers / Business Expenses) on the same life as a personal Workability — cross-policy (personal + business) state. Best encoded once the Business-policy cover specs exist (next cluster). Workability↔M&L/IP exclusivity is verified as AC08 above; legacy DC-28 also confirms the personal-side exclusivity.
